The Chinese characters for Heather

As a transliteration, Heather is usually written 希瑟 (Xī sè). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

瑟
sè

Origin and meaning

Heather comes from English and means “the heather plant”.

About the name Heather

A nature name from the flowering heather plant, big in the 1970s.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Heather carries the meaning “the heather plant” and looks striking in brush strokes.
